physical_topology.rule: Prefer logical schema and role separation; require evidence before physical database or server separation.

role_contracts.viewer_read: Read only on explicitly published schemas/views.
role_contracts.unit_writer: One least-privilege role per owning cutover unit; no cross-unit grants by default.
role_contracts.publisher: Transactional publication on its approved dependency cluster only.
role_contracts.migration: DDL and backfill only during approved migration windows; not an application credential.
role_contracts.audit_reader: Read audit and migration evidence without mutation privilege.
